heading: Power to certify copies, etc. of specified documents or specified document records
content:
36H.
Power to certify copies, etc. of specified documents or specified document records
The Building Authority or a public officer authorized by the Building Authority may certify a copy, a print or an extract of or from a specified document or a specified document record as a true copy, print or extract of or from the specified document or the specified document record.
(Added 20 of 2008 s. 24)
